Our research team came out of the Stanford Artifical Intelligence Labs and the Cornell Robot Learning Lab.

aiResearchSummary.text: Jido Maps is researching methods for detecting objects and localizing a mobile computing device within an environment. The approach involves recording a series of frames and motion data, then detecting relative positions of a 3D constellation of objects to generate classifications. This aligns with their focus on providing an API for persistent augmented reality, highlighting their work in object detection, device localization, and spatial mapping for AR applications.
